Merge native Adam and distributions after source-bound qualification

Admit the exact 378-function HIA composition after both 68-step native jobs, all six head checks, the original 50-report artifact, root review and independent source/report/history review. Keep fixed 183/24 ledgers, live32/frozen35, original expected legacy failure and all open whole-project gates. Preserve newly observed inherited scalar-add NaN and pointwise-layout gaps for the public-gradient successor; no claim of complete PyTorch compatibility.
